result:
Both changes are made and committed. I believe both acceptance reds are fixed, but I haven't run `gov accept` because it crashes in the sandbox; the lead needs to run it outside.

**Step 0 (sandbox check): passed.** (a) Writing `.sandbox-trial-DAEO-emq1` was refused with `Read-only file system`. (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` worked (`1ae28402…`) and `git update-index --refresh` exited 0. The `ps` check for ollama or llama-server shows nothing of mine.

task: DAEO-emq1 (W2-115), run 5, eng-7: the owner's P1-K (a), which drops the fallback (R2-1), and R2-5's run-line fix.
status: DONE. The reds should be fixed: both acceptance cases run in a project where `head_without_change` now returns None, and a None base makes every red the change's, so `gov close` refuses `RED_CAUSED`.
work_completed:
- `select.head_without_change(root, green)` returns the green base when it is an ancestor of HEAD, and None otherwise. I removed the `own_base` parameter, and its one caller in `select.scoped` passes only `green`. `--base` works as before.
- `attribution.attribute` with `base is None` already treated the run without the change as ABSENT, so every red there counts as caused. This was checked by a unit test. Its reason text is corrected to "no head without the change: no green base on HEAD's line is known, so the red is the change's".
- The docstrings and the `--base` help text in `command.py` no longer name the fallback.
- Doc line 34 of `docs/research/W2-115-smart-close.md` now runs without `-I`.
files_changed: `src/gov/close/select.py`, `src/gov/close/attribution.py`, `src/gov/close/command.py` (help text only), `tests/unit/close/test_w2_115_select.py`, `tests/unit/close/test_w2_115_attribution.py`, `tests/unit/close/test_w2_115_close.py`, `docs/research/W2-115-smart-close.md`.
evidence:
- Sandbox check and `ps` check: as above.
- `gov.__file__` is `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-115/src/gov/__init__.py`.
- Red first: before the change, 3 failed and 45 passed (the two revised select cases and the new attribution case).
- `tests/unit/close`: `157 passed, 426 deselected in 44.71s`.
- Strict suites (F4: `tests/unit/close`, W1-30, W2-07, W2-57, W2-66): `327 passed, 1092 deselected in 534.89s (0:08:54)`.
- Commit `1b400c263`: trailers `Task: DAEO-emq1`, `Role: engineer`, `Implements: DEC-988, DEC-989, DEC-1083, DEC-983`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Commit `34601a7ba`: trailers `Task: DAEO-emq1`, `Role: engineer`, `Implements: DEC-983`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- `git status --short` is clean. `du -sh $TMPDIR` is 40K.
- All runs went through `heavy_slot.sh`; I met no refusals.
tests: S4/F1 has 5 changed or new cases:
- In select, two revised cases. A green base that is not an ancestor, with an own commit present, gives None. No green record gives None.
- In attribution, one new case: with no base, a red the parent also has is caused, with the new reason.
- In close, one new case: no green record and a red the oldest own commit's parent also has gives `RED_CAUSED`, with no record and no repair ticket. This matches red (b).
- Two existing close cases (S5 unowned red, S4 latency rounds) depended on the fallback. They now plant a green night with `green_night(repo)` first, so a green base on HEAD's line exists.
- The brief's `-k` filter leaves out 1 case, in `test_run_and_record.py`. `-m "not local_only"` leaves out none. The 425 deselected per `tests/unit/close` run come from `tests/conftest.py`'s own default deselection, not from the brief's filters.
discoveries: How I checked without the acceptance files: reds-7 shows both cases closing with `caused: false` because the run on the head without the change used the old fallback. The new select tests show `chosen["base"]` is None in both setups (green base not an ancestor, and no green record). The new close test reproduces red (b) and now refuses `RED_CAUSED`.
risks: As the ticket notes, a project with no green base on HEAD's line now refuses every red, including EXAMIN's copy at W2-27's first closes. The CTO is to bring that question to the owner before this lands.
lessons: none
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: The brief limited the doc change to line 34, so two passages in `docs/research/W2-115-smart-close.md` are now stale. Line 30 still says "`-I` keeps the records' folder out of the import path". The fix round 1 F-1 paragraph (around line 174) still describes the dropped fallback. Should either be changed?
recommended_next_action: The lead runs `gov accept W2-115` outside the sandbox to confirm both reds, then decides whether to fix the two stale doc passages.
